name: westwood_online_upgrade_download_create_instance_and_advise
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDownload::CreateInstanceAndAdvise creates the standalone download COM object, creates the matching download event sink, and advises the object through the download event-sink connection point while storing the advise cookie.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The WOL download CLSID/IID objects now use BN-backed GUID bytes; owner/data promotion still requires the full download event-sink owner gate and data-owner review.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/HLIL for 0x4422a0 validates the no-argument helper shape, CoCreateInstance call with CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, g_CLSID_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDownload, g_IID_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDownload, and g_pWestwoodOnlineUpgradeDownload out pointer, ignored CoCreateInstance HRESULT, WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDownloadEventSink::CreateInstance call, direct event-sink pointer advise, zCom::ConnectionPointContainer_Advise call with IID_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDownloadEventSink and g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDownloadAdviseCookie, and returning the advise HRESULT.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_download_create_instance_advise_smoke patches CoCreateInstance and verifies COM identity arguments, stored download object pointer, created event sink, live-count increment, connection-point advise call, sink pointer passed through offset zero, stored advise cookie, and release of the transient connection-point/container providers.
